title: MahaStroke
description: An experimental stroke risk estimation tool built with an emphasis on transparency and interpretability. Instead of presenting a single opaque result, the system exposes how different factors contribute to the final risk score, including which inputs reduce risk and which increase it.

title: MahaConvert
description: A versatile file conversion tool that supports a wide range of formats, enabling users to easily convert documents, images, audio, and video files. Designed for simplicity and speed, MahaConvert aims to streamline the file conversion process for both personal and professional use.

title: MahaInsight
description: MahaInsight is a data visualization platform that presents verified, open datasets through clear and transparent analysis. It focuses on interpretability, source traceability, and reproducible insights rather than opaque conclusions.

title: SiBudget
description: Stop manual logging and start chatting. Use conversational AI to link your emotions with your spending and curb impulsive habits.

title: MahaDiscipline
description: An accountability experiment built around consistency, friction, and self-honesty. Instead of motivation, it focuses on tracking reliability over time and exposing patterns users usually avoid confronting.

title: PetaSight
description: An intuitive geospatial visualization platform built to analyze multi-dimensional data with a clean, modern user interface.
